The user approved replacing PR #914 from current main with its five specified non-merge commits, excluding the Claw-pin hunks. This step restores the nine explicit tombstone representatives, retains reviewed form-specific rejection-ledger decisions, and regenerates exports, indexes, unified snapshot/provenance and the native current review.

Acceptance: zero REJECTED unified rows with an empty mim_id; zero kgmicrobe.compound unified rows carrying CHEBI; all nine tombstones have representative. Full native QC, receipt-chain validation and independent final-head adversarial review precede a squash merge through the queue. The old #914 branch is not rewritten; the PR will be closed with its replacement pointer only after the replacement merges.

Approved plan SHA256: `99b7746742f70c7896ed163a833a8b214282dba84567dc3213ec0a2b194e4d90`. Related: #869, #882, #894, #808.
